subtasks.description: Declare all internal wires and regs needed to interconnect sub-modules, carry status/control signals, and hold muxed master Wishbone outputs.

Instantiate all child modules (sd_controller_wb, sd_clock_divider, sd_cmd_master, sd_cmd_serial_host, sd_data_master, sd_data_serial_host, tx_bd, rx_bd, sd_fifo_tx_filler, sd_fifo_rx_filler) and wire their ports to the declared glue signals.
Assemble internal status registers (Bd_status_reg, status_reg bits, normal_int_status_reg, error_int_status_reg, Bd_isr_reg) using continuous assignments as specified in the Register Update table.
constraints: All assignments must be continuous; no sequential logic shall be introduced.

subtasks.description: Multiplex master Wishbone interface outputs (m_wb_adr_o, m_wb_dat_o, m_wb_cyc_o, m_wb_stb_o, m_wb_cti_o, m_wb_bte_o, m_wb_we_o) based on start_tx_fifo and start_rx_fifo; assign m_wb_sel_o to 4'b1111.
constraints: All muxed signals must be combinational; m_wb_sel_o is a constant 4'b1111.

subtasks.description: Generate combinational interrupt outputs int_a, int_b, int_c by ANDing each interrupt status register with its enable register, then OR reducing, gated by SDC_IRQ_ENABLE.
constraints: Interrupt outputs must be combinational; no registers or latching.

subtasks.description: Select sd_clk_o source based on compile-time defines; generate internal reset (wb_rst_i OR software_reset_reg[0]) and sd_cmd_serial_host reset (internal_rst OR go_idle_o); assign sd_clk_o_pad = sd_clk_o.
constraints: Use ifdef or parameter for clock selection; sd_clk_o_pad must equal sd_clk_o.
